				}
			}
			amd_run_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					amd_run_apply = yes
				}
			}
			amd_tab1_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {

		context_type = player_context

			has_country_flag = amd_gui_open

		triggers = {

	amd_tab5_gui = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "amd_tab5"
		parent_window_name = "amd_window"
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = amd_gui_open
			check_variable = { amd_tab = 5 }
		}
		dirty = ROOT.amd_list_rev
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		triggers = {
			amd_fm_empty_visible = { check_variable = { amd_fm_n = 0 } }

						event_target:amd_fm_23 = { set_variable = { amd_rank = ROOT.amd_fm_pts_23 } }
					}
					amd_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			amd_fm_24_dec_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = -99 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = -99 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 1 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = -99 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 2 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 1 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 3 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 2 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 4 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 3 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 0 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 4 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 6 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 0 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 7 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 6 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 8 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 7 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 9 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 8 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 5 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 4 } }
					else = { set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 0 } }
					if = { limit = { has_event_target = amd_fm_24 }
						event_target:amd_fm_24 = { set_variable = { amd_rank = ROOT.amd_fm_pts_24 } }
					}
					amd_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			amd_fm_24_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = -99 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 1 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 1 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 2 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 2 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 3 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 3 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 4 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 4 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 0 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 0 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 6 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 6 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 7 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 7 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 8 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 8 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 9 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 9 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 9 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 5 } } set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 6 } }
					else = { set_variable = { amd_fm_pts_24 = 0 } }
					if = { limit = { has_event_target = amd_fm_24 }
						event_target:amd_fm_24 = { set_variable = { amd_rank = ROOT.amd_fm_pts_24 } }
					}
					amd_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
